fields.statement: Change set 01M7M2FB (rhiza run spawn can return): should returning once the child starts be opt-in on rhiza run spawn (a new --no-wait flag; waiting stays the default) or the new default (spawn always returns at start)? / Change set 01M7M2FB: who sends the conductor its wake-up message (rhiza session message) when a --no-wait child ends? / Change set 01M7M2FB: the intent says a child's 'blocked question' also wakes the conductor. In a conductor step the arbiter already answers a child's question. What should wake the conductor?
